instagram.content:
Brothers and sisters, the Lord says, “Be still, and know that I am God” (Ps 46:10). In the rush of today, pause. Let His presence settle your heart. He is already moving your breakthrough; you only need to stand firm in faith.  

Declare: I will walk in the authority of the Almighty today.  

What piece of His peace have you felt this morning?
